INTERROGATION RECORD: HESPER WRENFIELD, OUTRIDER

Copied into the ash-black register. The original leaves are smoke-
stained, and several answers have been marked as unfit for
repetition.

Subject: Hesper Wrenfield Standing: Outrider Birth: 404 AS
Classification: A minor figure of the Ashen Era Description: No
canonical physical features are established for Hesper Wrenfield;
their visual identity is limited to their role as an Outrider.
Demeanor: No canonical temperament is established for Hesper
Wrenfield.

---

EXAMINER: State your name for the record.

HESPER WRENFIELD: Hesper Wrenfield.

EXAMINER: Your station?

HESPER WRENFIELD: Outrider.

EXAMINER: Your birth year?

HESPER WRENFIELD: 404 AS.

EXAMINER: You understand why you have been brought here?

HESPER WRENFIELD: I understand that a door was opened, and I was
told to enter.

EXAMINER: That is not an answer.

HESPER WRENFIELD: It is the answer I possess.

[Here the examiner has drawn a line through the margin. The ink has
been pressed so hard that the page is torn.]

EXAMINER: You serve whom?

HESPER WRENFIELD: I serve as an Outrider.

EXAMINER: I asked whom.

HESPER WRENFIELD: You asked a different question after I answered
the first.

EXAMINER: What did you carry beyond the ash road?

HESPER WRENFIELD: The road carried itself. I carried nothing worth
your seal.

EXAMINER: Did you see the signal?

HESPER WRENFIELD: I saw many things.

EXAMINER: *Did you see the signal?*

HESPER WRENFIELD: If I did, then it has already been seen.

*[A pause is entered here. No duration is supplied. The recorder*
*notes that the lamp guttered, though no draft is mentioned.]*

EXAMINER: Name the hand that gave the order.

HESPER WRENFIELD: Orders have hands only when written.

EXAMINER: Was it written?

HESPER WRENFIELD: You have the paper.

EXAMINER: *The paper bears no name.*

HESPER WRENFIELD: Then it bears no answer.

EXAMINER: You mistake refusal for safety.

HESPER WRENFIELD: You mistake noise for truth.

*[At this point the record becomes irregular. Several questions are*
*preserved only as black strokes. No confession is entered. No*
*accusation is formally concluded.]*

EXAMINER: One final matter. Are you Hesper Wrenfield, minor figure
of the Ashen Era, born in 404 AS, serving as an Outrider?

HESPER WRENFIELD: That is what your record says.

EXAMINER: And what do you say?

HESPER WRENFIELD: I have said my name.

CLOSING NOTE: The subject’s canonical physical features remain
unestablished. No canonical temperament is established. The record
therefore permits no reliable description beyond the stated role:
Outrider.
